title: Structure and single-molecule magnet behavior of a rhombus-shaped Dy4 cluster

material_class.structural_family: rhombus-shaped Dy4 cluster with distorted square-antiprismatic Dy(III) geometry

synthesis.procedure: Dy(beac)3·2H2O (0.02 mmol) and HL (0.02 mmol) were dissolved in mixed CH3CN/CH2Cl2 (25.0 mL, v/v 4/1) for about 30 min at room temperature. The mixture was enclosed in a 100.0 mL round-bottomed flask and heated at 70 °C for 4 h, then cooled to room temperature. After filtration, the solution was kept in a refrigerator and concentrated slowly by evaporation at 4 °C. After about 5 days, yellow block-shaped crystals suitable for X-ray analysis were obtained.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature dissolution; heated at 70 °C; crystallization at 4 °C
synthesis.time: about 30 min dissolution; 4 h heating; about 5 days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 100.0 mL round-bottomed flask; mixed CH3CN/CH2Cl2 (25.0 mL, v/v 4/1)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to room temperature, filtered, then concentrated slowly by evaporation in a refrigerator at 4 °C to give yellow block-shaped crystals

properties.summary: Tetranuclear Dy4 cluster 1 shows SMM behavior with slow magnetic relaxation under zero dc field. χMT is 56.78 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K and falls to 29.24 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.0 K, attributed to Dy(III) Stark-level depopulation and/or weak antiferromagnetic Dy···Dy interactions. Frequency-dependent ac signals, Arrhenius analysis, Cole–Cole α values, and field-dependent QTM suppression (optimum Hdc = 1500 Oe, dual relaxation under that field) are reported. Advertised barrier ΔE/kB = 78.3 K and τ0 = 4.4 × 10−7 s (abstract/conclusion; section 3.3 also prints τ0 = 4.4 × 10−6 s).
